title: Offline client store startup and reconnect baseline
description: Run five times on an isolated, paired iOS dev client with a self-contained pending gate. IOS_SIMULATOR and METRO_PORT select its own stack. Records native startup timing and actual received gateway bytes without changing application data.

proofTargets.claim: The real Companion reads its run list after a cold launch and automatic socket reconnect.
Companion reads a nonempty diff for the pending gate's workspace and renders its diff screen.

cold-start.intent: Relaunch the real app and measure its first successful run list read.

assert-cold.intent: Require a cold-start receipt from the connected app.

reconnect.intent: Close the actual socket and measure the client's automatic recovery.

assert-reconnect.intent: Require a reconnect receipt from the connected app.

open-diff.intent: Open the real gate workspace and measure its matching diff read.

assert-diff.intent: Require actual diff content from the selected workspace.

diff-screen.intent: Verify the real run diff screen is visible.

diff-content.intent: Verify the live workspace diff loaded instead of an unavailable artifact.

capture-diff.intent: Record the rendered gate workspace diff.
